Name: SubtlyLiminal's Mobile Phone Themes
Author: SubtlyLiminal
Description:
WOW, I didn't realize how big I made this until I checked to see how many variations I have.

Skins come in various colors, and include variants with stickers, a cracked screen, or both.  Backgrounds are pretty simple designs.  Stripes, simple black and white, upside-down goth crosses, plus parsnips, Elliott drunkenly dancing at the Saloon, and some glitched out screens based on a pixelated version of one of the backgrounds in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18093]my other Mobile Phone backgrounds mod[/url].

To install, copy the "Backgrounds" and "Skins" folders in this mod into [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]'s assets folder.  You can then change your phone's theme in game.

I've also included a editable psd with instructions in the optional files, so you can make your own variations and edits of my skins!

Thank you to aedenthorn for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url], and to JoXW for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017?tab=description]Mobile Phone Continued[/url]!
